reviews.title: Great memory @ $234.99 but not at $589.99
reviews.comment: Runs at 8000mt, very impressed...Timings can be tightened so running at CL36-48-48-96, slightly more voltage and a few other settings and it is rock solid, lower latency and snappier, temps have never exceeded 45c...One caveat however, I paid 234.99 October 1st, it is now 589.99, a 151% increase in price...no longer worth looking at...
